name: Wookstar Claude Plugins
headline: Wookstar Claude Plugins - Operations
short_description: An opinionated plugin pack for Claude Code. Skills, Commands, Hooks, MCPs organised in thematic "bundles" to cover productivity, development, Google Analytics & Google Tag Manager,  Shopify and a few other bits
author: henkisdabro

sections.overview:
Wookstar Claude Code Plugins is a curated marketplace offering 34 independently installable plugins organized across eight categories: Development (toolkit, Cloudflare, React/Next.js, Shopify, userscripts, Google Apps Script), Analytics (GTM, GA4, Google Ads), AI (Gemini, Codex, MCP servers), Productivity (email drafts, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Notion, n8n, Excalidraw), Content (Word, Excel, PDF, FFmpeg, text humanization), Data (stocks, crypto, FX rates), Utilities (timezone, HTTP fetch, MikroTik, weather), and LSP servers (Bash, CSS, HTML, JSON, Tailwind, YAML). Install plugins selectively using the `/plugin install` command within Claude Code or via terminal. Each plugin integrates as standalone skills, commands, hooks, or MCP servers without requiring the entire pack.
Automate GTM and GA4 analytics workflows with built-in MCP servers
Develop Shopify themes and apps with Liquid, GraphQL, and REST API references
Generate rich-text email and WhatsApp drafts with live browser preview
Access Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, R2, and DNS management through 2,500+ API endpoints
